package storage

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "net/http"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
)
func TestS3CompatibleAdapter(t *testing.T){
 t.Setenv("AWS_REGION","us-east-1")
 t.Setenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID","test")
 t.Setenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY","test")
 t.Setenv("AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED","true")
 t.Setenv("S3_PATH_STYLE","true")
 server:=httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter,r *http.Request){
  if r.URL.Path!="/documents/file.txt"{t.Errorf("path-style request: %s",r.URL.Path)}
  switch r.Method{
  case "PUT":
   body,err:=io.ReadAll(r.Body);if err!=nil{t.Error(err)}
   if !strings.Contains(string(body),"payload"){t.Errorf("missing upload content: %q",body)}
   if r.Header.Get("Content-Type")!="text/plain"{t.Error("content type missing")}
   w.Header().Set("ETag",`"test"`)
  case "GET":
   w.Header().Set("Content-Type","text/plain")
   fmt.Fprint(w,"payload")
  case "DELETE":w.WriteHeader(204)
  default:t.Errorf("unexpected operation %s",r.Method)
  }
 }))
 defer server.Close()
 t.Setenv("S3_ENDPOINT",server.URL)
 ctx:=context.Background()
 store,err:=OpenS3(ctx);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=store.Put(ctx,"documents","file.txt",strings.NewReader("payload"),7,"text/plain");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 object,err:=store.Get(ctx,"documents","file.txt");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 body,err:=io.ReadAll(object.Body);_ = object.Body.Close()
 if err!=nil || string(body)!="payload" || object.ContentType!="text/plain"{t.Fatalf("invalid object: %+v %v",object,err)}
 url,err:=store.PresignGet(ctx,"documents","file.txt",time.Minute)
 if err!=nil || !strings.Contains(url,"/documents/file.txt?") || !strings.Contains(url,"X-Amz-Signature"){t.Fatalf("invalid presign: %s %v",url,err)}
 if err:=store.Delete(ctx,"documents","file.txt");err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if _,err:=store.PresignGet(ctx,"documents","file.txt",8*24*time.Hour);err==nil{t.Fatal("invalid expiration accepted")}
}
